events.factual_description: Roulette presents Sō Laboratories in Memory of Tim Thomas on Tuesday, September 15, 2026. Doors are at 7:00 PM and the performance begins at 8:00 PM. The event is free with RSVP and is presented by Sō Percussion in partnership with Roulette. Roulette states that Tim Thomas (1966–2026) died in January 2026 and describes the evening as a celebration of his life through Sō Laboratories, the series he loved and guided. The announced billing is Sō Percussion + Friends, with Matt Evans (percussion), Amy Garapic (percussion), Charlotte Greve (alto saxophone), Sruly Lazaros, Dani Matei (percussion), Beth Meyers (viola), Drew Neal (percussion), Dylan Offrais (percussion), Pat Swoboda (bass), and Philippa Thompson. Roulette also states that the concert will be livestreamed free at 8:00 PM and archived for future viewing.

en.why_it_matters: The reason this belongs is the memorial structure, not simply Sō Percussion's reputation. Thomas helped guide Sō Laboratories, and the series becomes the language for remembering him: a percussion-heavy circle of musicians gathering around the experimental community he supported. That gives the evening a real human and musical context rather than the feel of a routine new-music bill.
en.trip_verdict: If a New York trip already lines up with September 15, this is worth folding into the evening at Roulette, especially because the reservation is free. From the DMV, I would pair it with another strong New York reason rather than build a dedicated trip around this single night; the free livestream also keeps the music accessible if the geography does not work.

es.why_it_matters: Lo que mete esta fecha al RADAR es la forma del memorial, no simplemente la reputación de Sō Percussion. Thomas ayudó a guiar Sō Laboratories y ahora la propia serie sirve como lenguaje para recordarlo: un círculo de músicos, con fuerte peso de la percusión, reunido alrededor de la comunidad experimental que él apoyó. Eso le da a la noche un contexto humano y musical concreto, no el aire de otra cartelera rutinaria de música nueva.
es.trip_verdict: Si un viaje a Nueva York ya coincide con el 15 de septiembre, vale incorporarlo a la noche en Roulette, sobre todo porque la reservación es gratuita. Desde el DMV lo combinaría con otra razón fuerte para subir, en vez de construir un viaje dedicado alrededor de esta sola fecha; el livestream gratuito también mantiene la música al alcance si la geografía no cuadra.
